verdict.rationale: TruffleHog documents its own pre-commit and pre-receive hooks and a CLI with `--fail` for gating commits. The pack has no evidence of wiring the scanner into a coding agent: no MCP server, no agent hook integration, no agent-facing docs, and llms.txt returns 404. Generic git hooks are an adjacent capability that belongs to a separate pre-commit story, so they earn no credit for agent integration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can wire the scanner into my coding agent so AI-generated code is scanned for issues before it lands
